sentences.en: Here at Hidden Brain, we're hard at work on new episodes for later this summer and fall.

sentences.en: So this week, we're going to bring you a story from our archives.

sentences.en: It aired first on the public radio show This American Life

sentences.zh: 那一期的标题是《心之所向》。

sentences.en: This story is slightly longer than our usual episode, and it's best heard in a single sitting.
sentences.zh: 这个故事比我们平时的节目稍长，最好一次性听完。

sentences.en: So we're going to give it to you without any interruptions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将不作任何中断地为您呈现。

sentences.en: Okay, this is the tale of a con that unfolded very slowly over two decades.
sentences.zh: 好了，这是一个骗局的故事，它在二十年间缓慢地展开。

sentences.en: What fascinates me about the story is that when the con was finally exposed,
sentences.zh: 这个故事最让我着迷的是，当骗局最终被揭穿时，

sentences.en: many of the victims were heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 许多受害者反而心碎不已。

sentences.en: They wanted it to go on.
sentences.zh: 他们希望骗局继续下去。
他们想继续相信这一切。

sentences.en: So here's how the con worked.
sentences.zh: 下面就是这个骗局的运作方式。

sentences.en: Guys around the country signed up for a pen pal service.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的男士们注册了一项笔友服务。

sentences.en: It would put them in touch with women they could befriend and correspond with.
sentences.zh: 它能让他们与可以结交并通信的女性取得联系。

sentences.en: And then they'd start to receive letters.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就会开始收到信件。
信件来自伊利诺伊州的希尔斯代尔。

sentences.en: Some of them are white, pink, green.

sentences.en: Jesse is a sweet, soft-spoken man with thick plastic aviator glasses.

sentences.en: He started receiving the letters in 1985, when he was in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 他从1985年开始收到这些信，当时他30多岁。

sentences.en: He'd never had a serious girlfriend, always lived with his parents.

sentences.en: and working at his family's restaurant.
Jesse's favorite letters came from a woman named Pamela.
sentences.zh: 杰西最喜欢的信来自一位名叫帕梅拉的女士。

sentences.en: Ah, yes, I usually took it at the end of the day when I got them in the mail,
sentences.zh: 啊，是的，我通常在一天结束时收到信，

sentences.en: went into my room, and laid on my bed and just sat there and read them.
sentences.zh: 回到房间，躺在床上，就坐在那里读它们。

sentences.en: Dear Jesse, deep down, you know as well as I do that you could be a lot better off than you are
